title: land and dispatch name a host item's branch and merge request by the kb id, so a workspace whose repositories enforce their own task-id branch and MR-title rules cannot land (Nerthus adoption)
goal: A multi-repository item with an external tracker id is dispatched on a branch and landed from merge requests named by a template backlog.json sets from that id (the Nerthus workspace: branch proj/<nn>-<mm>-<slug>, MR title '<task id>: <title>', a 'Task: <task id>' trailer), so a host whose repositories' CI refuses any other branch name, MR title or trailer lands an item without changing those rules; with no template set the kb's work/<id> and '<id>:' stay the default

run: import sys,inspect; sys.path.insert(0,"_tools"); import bl_land,bl_dispatch; a="title_prefix=f\"{iid}:\"" in inspect.getsource(bl_land.land_repositories); b="WORK_PREFIX + iid" in inspect.getsource(bl_dispatch.worker_branch); sys.exit(1 if a and b else 0)

repro_reason: landing needs a live forge with merged requests; the names are fixed by these two expressions in land_repositories and worker_branch
